spec: specification/requirements.mdx §Inference: requirement inference is transitive through ordinary calls
specification/failures.mdx §Cleanup: using and await using retain TypeScript resource-management semantics
specification/requirements.mdx §Must Consume: Results and started Promises must not be discarded
prelude: import { Context } from 'vibelang/context'; import { Layer } from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class Db extends Context { abstract read(): string } abstract class Log extends Context { abstract read(): string } const seen: string[] = []; const db: Db = { read: () => 'DB' }; const log: Log = { read: () => 'LOG' }; class Boom extends Error {}

cases.name: sync disposal charges its capability
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: provided sync disposal runs before leaving its Layer
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), () => f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: async disposal charges its capability
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } const work = f(); await work; export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: provided async disposal survives await
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), async () => await f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: await using charges the sync fallback
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: provided await using sync fallback
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), async () => await f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: definite async disposal does not charge the unused sync method
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Log.context().read()) } async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), async () => await f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: using does not select async disposal
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { seen.push(Log.context().read()) } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), () => f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: optional async disposal keeps the sync fallback row
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.asyncDispose]?: () => Promise<void>; [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: nullish async disposal keeps the sync fallback row
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.asyncDispose]: (() => Promise<void>) | null = null; [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: any async disposal cannot erase the sync fallback row
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.asyncDispose]: any = undefined; [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: provided nullish async disposal runs the sync fallback
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.asyncDispose]: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined = undefined; [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), async () => await f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: union resources retain both possible disposal rows
cases.source: class A { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } class B { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Log.context().read()) } } async function f(flag: boolean): Promise<void> { await using r = flag ? new A() : new B(); } await f(true); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: a disposal property follows its function alias
cases.source: function clean(): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } class Resource { [Symbol.dispose] = clean } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: the disposer getter and its returned function both contribute
cases.source: function clean(): void { seen.push(Log.context().read()) } class Resource { get [Symbol.dispose]() { seen.push(Db.context().read()); return clean } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: for using charges each iteration value
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } function f(): void { for (using r of [new Resource(), new Resource()]) {} } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: provided for using disposes on continue and break
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } function f(): void { let index = 0; for (using r of [new Resource(), new Resource(), new Resource()]) { if (++index === 1) continue; break } } Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(Db, db), () => f()); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: for await using charges its disposal method
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } async function f(): Promise<void> { for (await using r of [new Resource()]) {} } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: unused resources do not cause implicit disposal
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(Db.context().read()) } } function f(): void { const r = new Resource(); seen.push('body') } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: null resources are inert
cases.source: function f(): void { using a = null; using b = undefined; seen.push('body') } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: pure disposals retain reverse acquisition order
cases.source: class Resource { constructor(readonly id: string) {} [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(this.id) } } function f(): void { using a = new Resource('a'), b = new Resource('b'); seen.push('body') } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: sync disposal cannot discard a Result
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): Result<void, Boom> { throw new Boom() } } function f(): Result<number, Boom> { using r = new Resource(); return 1 } export function main() { return String(f().unwrapOr(0)) }

cases.name: async disposal cannot discard an awaited Result
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<Result<void, Boom>> { throw new Boom() } } async function f(): Promise<Result<number, Boom>> { await using r = new Resource(); return 1 } export async function main() { return String((await f()).unwrapOr(0)) }

cases.name: sync disposal cannot start an unowned Promise
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.dispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push('late') } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: inferred sync disposal cannot forward an unowned Promise
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { return Promise.resolve() } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: inferred sync disposal cannot forward a discarded Result
cases.source: function read(): Result<void, Boom> { throw new Boom() } class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { return read() } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: a disposal return union cannot hide a Promise
cases.source: class Resource { constructor(readonly flag: boolean) {} [Symbol.dispose](): Promise<void> | undefined { return this.flag ? Promise.resolve() : undefined } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(true); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: a disposal return union cannot hide a Result
cases.source: function read(): Result<void, never> { return } class Resource { constructor(readonly flag: boolean) {} [Symbol.dispose](): Result<void, never> | undefined { return this.flag ? read() : undefined } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(true); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: a disposer cannot transfer a Result into discarded data
cases.source: function read(): Result<void, Boom> { throw new Boom() } class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { return { result: read() } } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: a disposer cannot transfer a Promise into a discarded array
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { return [Promise.resolve()] } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: native disposal may still discard ordinary data
cases.source: class Resource { [Symbol.dispose]() { seen.push('disposed'); return { value: 1 } } } function f(): void { using r = new Resource(); seen.push('body') } f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

cases.name: await using does not await a sync disposal return value
cases.source: class Resource { async [Symbol.dispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push('late') } } async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = new Resource(); } await f(); export function main() { return seen.join(',') }

foreignCases.name: foreign sync disposal
foreignCases.source: import { resource } from './foreign.ts'; export function f(): void { using r = resource; }

foreignCases.name: foreign async disposal
foreignCases.source: import { asyncResource } from './foreign.ts'; export async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = asyncResource; }

foreignCases.name: foreign sync fallback
foreignCases.source: import { resource } from './foreign.ts'; export async function f(): Promise<void> { await using r = resource; }

foreignCases.name: type assertions cannot hide foreign disposal
foreignCases.source: import { resource } from './foreign.ts'; export function f(): void { using r = (resource as unknown as Disposable); }

foreignCases.name: a trusted factory does not certify its disposer
foreignCases.source: import { getResource } from './foreign.ts'; export function f(): void { using r = getResource(); }
